title: Fluid design proposal (Joel gate)
goal: Before any styling reaches the engine, Joel approves a concrete visual interpretation of the Fluid state for writing and reading.
scope: Five bullets with exact values: type stacks (system serif/sans per OS), sizes, line height, measure in ch; vertical rhythm; light/dark colours (body contrast ≥ 7:1); caret and selection colours; read-mode multi-column threshold; minimal chrome (mode toggle, save state)
One isolated prototype bench/design/fluid-prototype.html (static, EN + DE fixtures, no engine)
Screenshots at 390/768/1280/1920 px × light/dark via Playwright, placed next to the bar screenshots in ~/DEV/ether/bars/ for Joel
Informational blind pre-check by the critic vs bar and floor, attached for Joel

rules.rule: Aesthetic work without a concrete reference: first 5 bullets with concrete values and one isolated prototype; real stylesheets only after approval.

Do not copy layout, text or brand of the bars.

floor: UA-default rendering of the same fixture

criteria: Five bullets with numeric values in docs/adr/0002-fluid-design.md (status: proposed).
